## Goal
- Execute the IVX 24/7 autonomous development mandate: 12 workers (W1–W12), 2-hour evidence-backed reports, complete the existing IVX production platform first (P0 queue), Autonomous Dashboard connected to a real job-ledger API in the owner-controlled repo, then app-from-scratch capability (W12/P2).

## Constraints & Preferences
- 12-worker model: W1 Architecture, W2 Owner auth, W3 Security/secrets, W4 Android/iOS stability, W5 Backend/Supabase, W6 Business modules, W7 Reels/chat/media, W8 Owner Dashboard/Admin Hub, W9 Testing/QA, W10 CI/CD, W11 Performance/monitoring, W12 App-generation
- Reports every 2 hours: number/window/timestamp/dashboard URL/screenshot + sections A–I (completed, running, blocked, approvals, builds, production, testing, 9 scores, next plan); if nothing verified, state "NO VERIFIED ENGINEERING PROGRESS DURING THIS WINDOW"
- Dashboard must use real job-ledger data (stable job IDs, commits, logs, artifacts, timestamps), not seed data; owner must see evidence per completed job and refresh showing real state changes
- P0 order: security/credentials → owner auth on physical Android → deployment identity → DB backup/recovery → final APK → critical crashes; P1: business reconciliation, chat, Owner Dashboard, CI/CD, dashboard live integration; P2: iOS build, performance, debt, app-from-scratch
- Definition of done: root cause + code + lint + TS + tests + build + commit + push + deploy + live verification + evidence + rollback; use VERIFIED only with direct evidence
- Owner approval only for: destructive data ops, irreversible migrations, credential rotation, DNS, payments, dangerous permissions, prod release per policy, risky rollback, app-store publication
- SECURITY: never print/persist passwords; owner sets password via official Supabase reset email only
- Owner token (~15 min TTL): `POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` body `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}` → `accessToken` (len 1540, method magiclink_token_hash); stored `/tmp/owner_token`
- `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` request shape: top-level `{action, confirm:true, confirmText, reason, input:{...}}` — action params MUST be nested under `input` (e.g. `input.path/content/message` for github_commit_file); confirmTexts: `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE`, `CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_MERGE`, `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY`, `CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE`, `CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION`
- Cloudflare WAF blocks deploy-action payloads ≥~200KB (HTTP 403 HTML "Blocked"); ≤100KB passes — cannot re-commit full `backend/hono.ts` (306KB) through the pipeline
- Deploy-action file path guard rejects secret-like paths (.env, .pem, .key, "secret", "private-key")
- Use `bun`/`bunx`; parse-check TS with `bun build <file> --target=bun --packages external`; Edit tool refuses `package.json` — patch via python3
- User states platform is Expo Go native (`expo/` dir) — dashboard integration should target the Expo app, not only the Swift preview app

## Progress
### Done
- **JOB-0015 VERIFIED — real job-ledger API deployed end-to-end**:
  - Authored `backend/api/ivx-autonomous-job-ledger.ts` (owner-only; `GET /api/ivx/autonomous/ledger`, `POST /api/ivx/autonomous/ledger/update`; W1–W12, 26 baseline jobs JOB-0001…0026, 5 approvals APR-001…005; durable store at `logs/audit/autonomous-job-ledger/ledger.json` via `readDurableJson`/`writeDurableJson`; immutable history; marker `ivx-autonomous-job-ledger-2026-07-17`)
  - WAF workaround: created `backend/hono-extended.ts` (imports `./hono` app, registers ledger routes) + updated `server.ts` to import `./backend/hono-extended`; reverted ledger edits from local `backend/hono.ts`
  - Commits via deploy API: `24fc272` (ledger API), `d7153a0` (hono-extended), `6bdadf4` (server.ts) → repo `github.com/ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest` main
  - `render_trigger_deploy` accepted (srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0); production /health now sha `6bdadf49`, boot 2026-07-17T20:29:17Z
  - Live verification: no-token GET → 401; owner GET → 200 (counts: 12 workers, 26 jobs, 5 pendingApprovals); POST update JOB-0015 RUNNING→VERIFIED (version 1→2, history 2 entries); re-GET reflects change; regression: /health 200 blockers [], `/api/ivx/autonomous-ops/dashboard` 200 ok
- Command Center Swift app (`ios-ivx-command-center`): 5 tabs (Overview/Workers/Jobs/Health/Approvals), dark theme amber tint, live /health probe; ContentView rewritten after template reset; runChecks PASSED; icon 1024px in AppIcon.appiconset
- SeedData restructured to 12 workers / 26 jobs / 5 approvals (Worker.swift comment fixed to 1–12)
- Reports #1 and #2 delivered; honest "No — not fully" completion answer given (~30% overall)
- Prior verified: arm64 APK v1.4.6(38) 45.3MB SHA `0b7ced1b…894c7` delivered; universal 85.9MB held (>50MB limit); password change/old-password-rejection + session revocation proofs; commits `6e011658`+`3e221781`; bundle secret scan clean

### In Progress
- Wire dashboard to live ledger API (todo item pending) — was inspecting Expo app structure: `expo/app/` routes (owner-access.tsx, live-operations-center.tsx, admin/, ivx/), `expo/lib/ivx-supabase-client.ts` has `IVX_CANONICAL_API_BASE_URL = 'https://api.ivxholding.com'`
- W9 QA matrices (JOB-0016/0017); W11 latency baselines (JOB-0018, health 0.77–1.45s)

### Blocked
- P0 password reset email: `/auth/v1/recover` HTTP 429 `over_email_send_rate_limit` (through 20:11 UTC)
- Service-role key rotation (APR-001): owner Supabase-dashboard action; old key in Git history
- Physical Android QA (JOB-0010): owner device required
- CI workflow registration (JOB-0012): GitHub token lacks workflow scope (HTTP 404); workflow uncommitted at `.github/workflows/build-apk-release.yml`
- DB backup verification (JOB-0011): backend missing SUPABASE_DB_URL/DATABASE_URL
- Release keystore (APR-003 / JOB-0008): owner approval required

## Key Decisions
- Built ledger routes as extension layer (`hono-extended.ts` + new `server.ts` entry) instead of editing `hono.ts`, because WAF blocks large commit payloads; all original routes preserved
- Endpoint routes chosen: `GET /api/ivx/autonomous/ledger`, `POST /api/ivx/autonomous/ledger/update` (owner-only via `assertIVXOwnerOnly`)
- Ledger persists in durable store; auto-seeds honest baseline on first read; version increments and history appends on each update
- Readiness scores: Vision 9, Features 9, Architecture 7, Consistency 5, QA 4, Security 6, Mobile 5, Traceability 8, Enterprise 5/10 (target 9)

## Next Steps
1. Wire the dashboard to live `GET /api/ivx/autonomous/ledger` (Expo app per user's "expo go native" directive — likely add owner screen under `expo/app/`; Swift app secondary), with auth via owner session bearer + controlled polling
2. Commit/deploy dashboard integration via deploy API (respect <100KB WAF limit per file)
3. Deliver next 2-hour report with JOB-0015 evidence (commits, deploy sha, state-change proof)
4. Retry reset email each session; continue W9 matrices, W1 mock-module inventory
5. Surface owner approvals APR-001…005 for action

## Critical Context
- Production: `https://api.ivxholding.com` /health sha `6bdadf49`, boot 2026-07-17T20:29:17Z, blockers []; Render service `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`; render.yaml repo = `https://rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu`; GitHub mirror `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest`
- Deploy timing: Render build+boot ~2 min after `render_trigger_deploy` (deployId returned null; poll /health for sha)
- Ledger state after verification: version 2, JOB-0015 VERIFIED, counts {verified:8, running:3, blocked:4, ownerActionRequired:3, queued:8}
- `owner-only.ts` guard: `assertIVXOwnerOnly` throws → return `ownerOnlyJson({ok:false,error},401)`; CORS origin `https://ivxholding.com`
- `bun build` without `--packages external` fails on unresolved `@supabase/supabase-js` (expo/shared/ivx/access-control.ts)
- Swift-app screenshots not capturable on current plan; running preview is the visual evidence
- Cannot capture screen recordings; sandbox env lacks AWS/GITHUB_TOKEN/RENDER_API_KEY/SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (server-side they exist)
- Local git HEAD `16fe7e3` "New version from Rork" (local repo diverges from deployed GitHub state — commits went via API, not local push)

## Relevant Files
- `backend/api/ivx-autonomous-job-ledger.ts`: new ledger API (committed `24fc272`, live)
- `backend/hono-extended.ts`: route extension layer (committed `d7153a0`)
- `server.ts`: entry now imports `./backend/hono-extended` (committed `6bdadf4`)
- `backend/hono.ts`: 306KB main app — too large for WAF; reverted to no-ledger state locally
- `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts`: deploy-action semantics (input nesting, confirmTexts, path guard, MAX_COMMIT_CONTENT_LENGTH 1.5M)
- `backend/api/owner-only.ts`: `assertIVXOwnerOnly`, `ownerOnlyJson`, `ownerOnlyOptions`
- `backend/services/ivx-durable-store.ts`: `readDurableJson`/`writeDurableJson`
- `expo/lib/ivx-supabase-client.ts`: canonical API base URL + env resolution for Expo app wiring
- `expo/app/`: Expo routes (owner-access.tsx, live-operations-center.tsx, admin/, ivx/) — target for dashboard integration
- `ios-ivx-command-center/IVXComm
